scope: Local component development findings; earlier failed reports remain unchanged.

findings.problem: Combined fixture supplied a 66-character encoded contract server hash to the bounded logical game server-id field.
findings.fix: Use the logical server id and assert its keccak hash equals the contract server id.

findings.problem: A pass-lock check raised unknown_transaction_intent when an acceptance UUID had been persisted before signed transaction preparation.
findings.fix: Unknown or not-yet-prepared acceptance remains locked and waits; the same funded job resumed without another purchase and paid exactly once.

findings.problem: Confirmed reverted acceptance prevented an expired pass lock from releasing.
findings.failure: Independent requester review reproduced the lock transition with an expired pass, pending operation and accepted=false.
findings.fix: The trusted canonical verifier distinguishes a confirmed revert from an unknown outcome; a usable pass stays locked, and explicit recovery clears only the failed attempt.
findings.verification: tests/settlement/local-locks.mjs: three focused actual-PostgreSQL checks with a declared scripted outcome verifier.

findings.problem: Initial local token fixture combined issuer and administrator accounts.
findings.fix: Separate immutable issuer and administrator authority; deploy v2 with seven distinct roles on the same owned chain; retain old contracts and settled jobs.

findings.problem: Fixed workflow-test destination accumulated valid deliveries across repeated isolated tests.
findings.fix: Use a unique destination per test run; product accounting was unchanged.
